question: Which people who left still have any GitHub access, and are there active GitHub accounts not linked to anyone?

queries.purpose: Count former people and active unlinked GitHub accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE employment_status = 'ended') AS ended_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM github_accounts WHERE status = 'active' AND person_id IS NULL) AS active_unlinked_github_accounts;

queries.purpose: List former people with active GitHub accounts or current organization, team, or direct repository grants.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.primary_email, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status AS account_status, ga.last_active_at, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gom.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gom.membership_id END) AS current_org_memberships, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gtm.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gtm.membership_id END) AS current_team_memberships, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') THEN grc.permission_id END) AS current_direct_repo_grants FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' GROUP BY p.person_id, p.full_name, p.primary_email, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status, ga.last_active_at HAVING ga.status = 'active' OR current_org_memberships > 0 OR current_team_memberships > 0 OR current_direct_repo_grants > 0 ORDER BY p.end_date, p.full_name;

queries.purpose: List active GitHub accounts that are not linked to an HR person and their current grants.
queries.sql: SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.email, ga.account_type, ga.status, ga.last_active_at, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gom.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gom.membership_id END) AS current_org_memberships, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gtm.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gtm.membership_id END) AS current_team_memberships, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') THEN grc.permission_id END) AS current_direct_repo_grants FROM github_accounts ga LEFT JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL GROUP BY ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.email, ga.account_type, ga.status, ga.last_active_at ORDER BY ga.login;

queries.purpose: Show current GitHub access paths and repositories for former people.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status AS account_status, 'organization' AS access_path, gom.membership_id AS access_record_id, NULL AS repository_id, NULL AS repository_name, gom.org_role AS access_level, gom.source AS grant_source FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' UNION ALL SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status, 'team_repository', gtrp.permission_id, r.repository_id, r.name, gtrp.permission, gtm.membership_id FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' UNION ALL SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status, 'direct_repository', grc.permission_id, r.repository_id, r.name, grc.permission, COALESCE(grc.approval_reference, '') FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' ORDER BY full_name, access_path, repository_name;

queries.purpose: Show all current access records for active GitHub accounts not linked to a person.
queries.sql: SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'organization' AS access_path, gom.membership_id AS access_record_id, NULL AS repository_id, NULL AS repository_name, gom.org_role AS access_level FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'team_repository', gtrp.permission_id, r.repository_id, r.name, gtrp.permission FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'direct_repository', grc.permission_id, r.repository_id, r.name, grc.permission FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL ORDER BY access_path, repository_name;

queries.purpose: Find successful GitHub activity after former employees' end dates.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ae.event_id, ae.occurred_at, ae.event_type, ae.actor_type, ae.actor_id, ae.target_type, ae.target_id, ae.source, ae.outcome FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN audit_events ae ON ae.system = 'github' AND ae.actor_type = 'account' AND ae.actor_id = ga.account_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' AND ae.outcome = 'success' AND ae.occurred_at >= p.end_date || 'T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY ae.occurred_at DESC;

report.summary: Yes. Thirteen former workers retain GitHub grants; three accounts remain active. One active service account is unlinked to any person, and two former-worker accounts show post-departure activity.

findings.title: Three former accounts active
findings.statement: Ariel Chen, Rowan Mercer, and Talia Brooks have active accounts, current organization membership, and repository access after leaving.

findings.title: Ten suspended accounts retain grants
findings.statement: Casey Cohen, Felix Garcia, Hugo Clark, Jae Thomas, Jonah Anders, Kai Mercer, Luis Kaur, Mateo Miller, Parker Choi, and Priya Petrov retain grants.

findings.title: Post-departure activity recorded
findings.statement: Rowan Mercer’s account pushed on August 14; Talia Brooks’s account fetched on August 13 and had other successful post-departure actions.

findings.title: Active unlinked service account
findings.statement: The active unlinked legacy-release-bot service account is an organization member with write access to payments-api and was active August 14.

findings.title: Suspension limits practical use
findings.statement: The ten suspended accounts likely cannot authenticate, but their unrevoked grants remain configured and could matter if account status changes.

data_gaps: Audit logs are incomplete, and account-attributed events do not prove which human performed an action.
recommended_actions: Immediately suspend the three active former-worker accounts and revoke their organization, team, and direct repository grants.
Investigate Rowan Mercer’s and Talia Brooks’s post-departure activity and preserve relevant GitHub logs.
Remove residual grants from the ten suspended former-worker accounts.
Identify an owner and business need for legacy-release-bot; rotate its credentials and remove unnecessary access.

proposed_tools.name: get_former_people_current_github_access
proposed_tools.description: Find former people whose GitHub accounts retain current organization, team-repository, or direct repository access. Returns person, account, grant, membership, and repository IDs for citation.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Snapshot timestamp used to exclude expired direct collaborator grants.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status AS account_status, 'organization' AS access_path, gom.membership_id AS access_record_id, NULL AS membership_id, NULL AS repository_id, NULL AS repository_name, gom.org_role AS access_level FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' UNION ALL SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status, 'team_repository', gtrp.permission_id, gtm.membership_id, r.repository_id, r.name, gtrp.permission FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' UNION ALL SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.status, 'direct_repository', grc.permission_id, NULL, r.repository_id, r.name, grc.permission FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > :snapshot_at) JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' ORDER BY full_name, access_path, repository_name

proposed_tools.name: get_active_unlinked_github_access
proposed_tools.description: List active GitHub accounts with no matched person and their current organization, team-repository, and direct repository grants.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Snapshot timestamp used to exclude expired direct collaborator grants.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.email, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'organization' AS access_path, gom.membership_id AS access_record_id, NULL AS membership_id, NULL AS repository_id, NULL AS repository_name, gom.org_role AS access_level FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.email, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'team_repository', gtrp.permission_id, gtm.membership_id, r.repository_id, r.name, gtrp.permission FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, ga.email, ga.account_type, ga.status, 'direct_repository', grc.permission_id, NULL, r.repository_id, r.name, grc.permission FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > :snapshot_at) JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE ga.status = 'active' AND ga.person_id IS NULL ORDER BY login, access_path, repository_name

proposed_tools.name: get_github_activity_after_departure
proposed_tools.description: Find successful GitHub events attributed to former workers’ accounts after their HR end date and through the snapshot.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Upper timestamp bound for audit events.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, ga.account_id, ae.event_id, ae.occurred_at, ae.event_type, ae.actor_type, ae.actor_id, ae.target_type, ae.target_id, ae.source, ae.outcome FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id = p.person_id JOIN audit_events ae ON ae.system = 'github' AND ae.actor_type = 'account' AND ae.actor_id = ga.account_id WHERE p.employment_status = 'ended' AND ae.outcome = 'success' AND ae.occurred_at >= p.end_date || 'T00:00:00Z' AND ae.occurred_at <= :snapshot_at ORDER BY ae.occurred_at DESC
